sentence: Hurry up! The bus going to leave.
ruleVi: Be going to cần có am / is / are; the bus là số ít nên dùng is.

sentence: I am going to visiting my grandparents this weekend.
ruleVi: Sau going to là động từ nguyên mẫu: going to visit.

sentence: We are going buy a new car next year.
ruleVi: Cấu trúc đầy đủ là be going to + động từ, không được bỏ to.

sentence: She are going to study medicine at university.
ruleVi: Chủ ngữ she đi với is: she is going to.

sentence: Minh is going to plays football after school.
ruleVi: Going to + động từ nguyên mẫu, không thêm -s.

sentence: Are you go to watch the match tonight?
ruleVi: Câu hỏi: Are + chủ ngữ + going to + động từ?

sentence: They not going to come to the party.
ruleVi: Phủ định: am / is / are + not + going to; they đi với aren't.

sentence: Be careful! The glass is going to falls.
ruleVi: Dự đoán có căn cứ: is going to + động từ nguyên mẫu.

sentence: What is you going to do this summer?
ruleVi: You đi với are: What are you going to do?

sentence: My parents is going to sell their old house.
ruleVi: Chủ ngữ số nhiều (my parents) đi với are going to.
